prompt: Create a moody cinematic close-up portrait of a mysterious young East Asian woman wearing an oversized black hoodie with the hood pulled up. Show dark hair slipping out from under the hood, a few fine strands crossing her face, smooth pale skin, softly defined lips, and an intense direct gaze with striking light blue eyes. Her hand is raised near her cheek, gripping the edge of the hoodie, wearing exactly 1 visible statement ring: a detailed silver skull ring with small horn-like shapes and dark recessed details. Use high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting with a narrow warm highlight across the center of her face and hand, deep black shadows around the hood, photorealistic skin texture, realistic fabric weave, sharp focus on the eyes and ring, cinematic elegance, ultra-detailed 8k realism, no text, no watermark.
